description: gs: where-you-are reminders, heads-ups when a step is skipped, and the automatic check. They never refuse anything and are silent outside a gs project.

hooks.command: python "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/gs.py" hook session-start --via python || python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/gs.py" hook session-start --via python3 || py "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/gs.py" hook session-start --via py

python "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/gs.py" hook user-prompt --via python || python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/gs.py" hook user-prompt --via python3 || py "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/gs.py" hook user-prompt --via py

python "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/gs.py" hook pre-tool --via python || python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/gs.py" hook pre-tool --via python3 || py "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/gs.py" hook pre-tool --via py

python "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/gs.py" hook post-tool --via python || python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/gs.py" hook post-tool --via python3 || py "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/gs.py" hook post-tool --via py

python "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/gs.py" hook post-tool --via python || python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/gs.py" hook post-tool --via python3 || py "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/gs.py" hook post-tool --via py

python "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/gs.py" hook stop --via python || python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/gs.py" hook stop --via python3 || py "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/gs.py" hook stop --via py
